title: Iron Trapdoor Fans
description: Makes iron trapdoors sounds a nice whirl, especially useful for when making moving fans out of trapdoors that bleed your ears. This was created for buildstone users who hate the sound of trapdoors when building big fans.
body:
Makes iron trapdoor sounds a nice whirl, especially useful for when making moving fans out of trapdoors that bleed your ears. This was created for buildstone users who hate the sound of trapdoors when building big fans. Doesn't affect wooden or copper trapdoors, if you want that please check my other pack.
